EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 433 September 11, 1974
CREATING A STUDY COMMITTEE OF STATE HIGHER EDUCATION
WHEREAS, the state higher education system accounts for more than P200 million of the budget of the
national government;
WHEREAS, the organization, location and fields of emphasis of the state higher education system need to be
evaluated in the light of development requirements;
WHEREAS, there is a need to rationalize the state higher education system to make it responsive to the needs
of national development;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue
of the powers vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby create a Study Committee on State Higher
Education which shall undertake a thorough study and assessment of the State University and College system
including other state- supported higher educational schools, and make recommendations for the formulation of
a policy framework to govern state higher education.
Specifically, the Committee shall:
1. analyze the performance of the government higher education system and its relevance to development
2. prepare a long-term perspective plan for the Philippine public higher education system, including the
estimate of resources needed and financial implications of the perspective plan;
3. identify and recommend policy measures affecting the higher education system, including the role of the
public and private sectors in education and the role of the University of the Philippines System in relation to
other state colleges and universities.
The Committee shall be composed of a Chairman, Vice-Chairman and three (3) members as follows:
Chairman ............. Secretary of Education & Culture & concurrent Chairman of the National Board of
Vice-Chairman ...... NEDA Director-General or his representative
Budget Commissioner or his representative
Presidential Commission on Reorganization Chairman or his representative
Education Development Projects Implementing Task Force Executive Director or his representative.
The Committee shall have the power to:
a. Adopt and prescribe the guidelines that will govern the study proper;
b. Solicit, when necessary, such assistance from both government and non-government entities as may be
required in the discharge of its functions;
c. Defray all expenses of the study including compensation of all the personnel; and
d. Perform such other acts as may be necessary and proper for the discharge of its functions and
responsibilities.
The Committee shall be assisted in its work by an Advisory Group, which is hereby constituted, consisting a
representative from each of the following:
1. Philippine Association of State Universities and Colleges
2. Philippine Association of Colleges and Universities
3. Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines
4. Association of Christian Schools & Colleges
5. Association of Colleges of Agriculture of the Philippines
6. Ad Interim Board for Technician Education
7. Fund for Assistance to Private Education
8. University of the Philippines
9. Mindanao State University
The Advisory Group shall advise the Committee in the task of formulating the policies that will govern the
higher educational system.
The Educational Projects Implementing Task Force (EDPITAF) shall provide the technical and administrative
support service for the Committee. The Committee may contract the services of competent persons and may
request the detail of personnel from the Department of Education and Culture, the National Economic and
Development Authority and other government agencies as may be necessary to assist the Committee in the
performance of its functions. The EDPITAF personnel assigned to the Committee as well as those contracted
and detailed personnel shall be granted such allowances for the duration of the project at such amounts as may
be determined by the Committee. The Executive Director of the EDPITAF shall be the Head of the Technical
Staff which shall be composed of the aforementioned personnel.
The Secretary of Education and Culture and the Director- General of the NEDA are hereby authorized to
allocate within their available funds such amounts as are appropriate and necessary for the operation of the
All government offices and instrumentalities thereof are hereby enjoined to extend all support and cooperation
to the Committee in the performance of its functions.
The Committee shall submit its report to the NEDA Board upon the expiration of this order.
This Order shall take effect immediately and shall in full force and effect for six months from the date of the
issuance hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
